user.title: Connect to your mower
user.description: Put the mower in Bluetooth pairing mode and enter its Bluetooth address. Enter the operator PIN if required.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Put the mower in pairing mode and enter its operator PIN if required.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to a compatible mower. Check Bluetooth range and pairing mode.

menu_options.setup_epos_origin: Set up Husqvarna Cloud EPOS origin

change_epos_boundary.title: Change {name}'s perimeter type
change_epos_boundary.description: Switching modes can erase virtual boundaries, work areas, stay-out zones and schedules. The mower needs an installed boundary wire to operate in wired mode.

data.confirm_epos_boundary: Confirm the change and possible loss of settings

setup_epos_origin.title: Set the EPOS origin
setup_epos_origin.description: Place {name} where it has a clear view of the sky and keep it in Bluetooth range. This selects Husqvarna Cloud for the empty installation profile and waits up to five minutes to register its current position as the origin.

data.confirm_epos_origin: Enable Husqvarna Cloud and register the origin

regenerate_aim_map.title: Regenerate the AIM map
regenerate_aim_map.description: Ask {name} to create an AIM map to replace the current one. The mower starts collecting data when it next mows on its schedule.

change_pin.title: Change the mower PIN
change_pin.description: Enter the current PIN and the new PIN for {name}. When the mower confirms the change, Home Assistant will reconnect with the new PIN.

reset.title: Reset mower user settings
reset.description: Restore the factory defaults on {name}. This can erase schedules, installation settings and map objects. The mower may restart and briefly disconnect.

data.confirm_reset: Restore factory defaults on this mower

progress.wifi_scanning: The mower is scanning for nearby Wi-Fi networks.
